hero.title: Special Intensive Revision (SIR) 2026
hero.subtitle: Update or verify your voter details to avoid issues during elections.

whatIsSIR.title: What is SIR?
whatIsSIR.description: SIR (Special Intensive Revision) is a process by the Election Commission to verify and update the voter list.
items: Incorrect or duplicate entries are removed
Your details are kept up to date

whyItMatters.title: Why this matters
whyItMatters.description: If your details are not correct or updated, your name may be missing from the voter list and you may face issues while voting.

whoShouldTakeAction.title: Who should take action?
items: You recently moved to a new address
You did not vote in previous elections
You changed your name or details
You received any notice from officials

steps.title: Check your name in the voter list
If incorrect, follow official instructions to update

importantTip.title: Important Tip
importantTip.description: Always use official ECI links. Avoid sharing personal details on unknown websites or with unauthorised persons.

footer.note: Information simplified from official Election Commission sources
